name: TableVQA-Bench
intro: TableVQA-Bench把WikiTableQuestions、TabFact和FinTabNet改造成包含表格图像、HTML与问答的视觉表格基准，形成VWTQ、VWTQ-Syn、VTabFact和FinTabNetQA四个子集，共1500组问答、894张表格图像。
build_method: 既有表格QA/事实核验数据改造、样式表与自定义渲染、GPT-4生成金融QA、人工复核
metric: 归一化准确率、真假分类准确率、FinTabNetQA宽松准确率
task_type: 表格问答, 文档理解
eval_feature: 四域视觉表格问答, 图像与HTML配对, 数据集专用答案规范化
build_method_en: Conversion of table-QA and fact-verification datasets, stylesheet and custom rendering, GPT-4 financial QA generation, and human review
eval_feature_en: Four-domain visual table QA, paired image and HTML, dataset-specific answer normalization
intro_en: TableVQA-Bench converts WikiTableQuestions, TabFact, and FinTabNet into a visual table benchmark containing table images, HTML, and QA. Its VWTQ, VWTQ-Syn, VTabFact, and FinTabNetQA subsets total 1,500 QA pairs over 894 table images.
metric_en: Normalized accuracy, true/false accuracy, and relaxed FinTabNetQA accuracy

drawio_review_note: Aligned with TableVQA-Bench arXiv:2404.19205 Sections 3-4; official naver-ai/tablevqabench repository and released dataset card. TableVQA-Bench converts WikiTableQuestions, TabFact, and FinTabNet into four visual table-QA subsets containing an image, HTML, and QA for every sample. VWTQ applies a Wikipedia stylesheet to WikiTableQuestions tables. VWTQ-Syn uses a custom renderer to create more varied styles. VTabFact renders TabFact tables and converts entailed or refuted statements into True or False questions. FinTabNet originally lacks QA, so GPT-4 generates questions and answers from text- and HTML-formatted financial tables; authors manually revise scale-unit errors. Tables with more than fifty rows are filtered and the authors review the released samples. The final benchmark contains 1,500 QA pairs over 894 table images: 750 VWTQ, 250 VWTQ-Syn, 250 VTabFact, and 250 FinTabNetQA. Evaluation sends the table image and question to each model, normalizes free-form answers for VWTQ and VWTQ-Syn, uses binary accuracy for VTabFact, and uses relieved accuracy that tolerates scale-unit variation for FinTabNetQA. Results are reported for every subset and as the benchmark aggregate.
